text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
"This might be our final goodbye, so let's 
take our time and talk when the moment 
comes."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't go letting go of it before me, 
Teach. ...I'm countin' on ya.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Just give me one more chance. I swear I'll 
win the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hello.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't look so spooked. It's not like 
we're strangers, after I looked after you 
back in the day, right?
choice_data_list: Why are you here all of a sudden...?
Why is it you, all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"The higher your hopes are piled, the more 
terrifying the pain when they come 
crashing down."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You haven't forgotten, have you? The 
despair that engulfed the world after an 
Umamusume gave them a glimpse of true 
greatness.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Those folks get wild and dream on their 
own, and then get frightened all on their 
own next.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Because I never want to experience that 
same sorrow ever again.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The public was in a complete frenzy back 
then, but since then, they haven't brought 
it up at all, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That remark certainly struck a chord with 
me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the day of last year's Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, numerous media outlets rushed to 
cover the race from their own respective 
angles.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the media reports regarding this 
year's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...
choice_data_list: It was far less than last year.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Because no Japanese Umamusume ran this 
year"? No, that's not it at all.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Their love for Paris faded. Simply because 
they were no longer favored.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...What a load of crap.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Once your fighting spirit burns out to 
cinders, it's over! All that's left is to 
be trampled by the strong!
choice_data_list: She won't be the one to get trampled

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Hah. How carefree.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka-sho. On this day, I 
was making final checks with Nakayama 
Festa in the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...You're unusually thorough today.
choice_data_list:
Because it's the final race of the Triple 
Crown route.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
This is the last chance to show what I can 
do. I gotta go out there and prove it.
